d: In the bustling beaches of a tropical resort, where the turquoise waters met the golden sands, worked a lifeguard named Wei. At 36, he was a tall, muscular Chinese man with a deceptive charm that hid his darkest fetish: necrophilia. He craved the lifeless bodies of young women, especially those who drowned, their abdomens swollen with swallowed seawater, and the frothy foam that bubbled from their mouths and noses when he pressed down. His victims were always beautiful East Asian women between 18 and 30, with modest A to C cup breasts, and straight hair ranging from shoulder-length to long, cascading like silk. Wei had perfected his routine: spot a potential victim, delay the rescue, "accidentally" ensure their demise, then perform futile "resuscitation" efforts while indulging in his desires, all while convincing any boyfriends, spouses, or friends that he was a hero doing everything possible. He maximized every moment until the ambulance sirens wailed in the distance, his heart racing with illicit ecstasy.
